infraGate.brief.aiWhy: A model read the command line and wrote this; AWOG did not derive it from the permission data. Check it against the command above before trusting it.
infraGate.brief.expect.context-switch: Changes which account and region the rest of this session runs against.
infraGate.brief.expect.destructive: Removes a resource. NOT reversible, not even by running the opposite command.
infraGate.brief.expect.read: Returns data to read. Changes nothing on the account.
infraGate.brief.expect.write: Changes the configuration or state of the resource it targets. Reversible if you know the previous value.
infraGate.brief.failed: Could not explain it — the three lines above are what AWOG derived itself.
infraGate.brief.loading: Asking a model to read the command…
infraGate.brief.risk.context-switch: Medium: every later command in this session lands in the new context.
infraGate.brief.risk.destructive: High: data or a resource is lost and cannot be recovered.
infraGate.brief.risk.production: You have marked this account as production.
infraGate.brief.risk.read: Low: it only reads, and changes nothing.
infraGate.brief.risk.shell: The command runs inside a shell string. The gate cannot pull the real command out of it, so it does not score the operation at all — it forces the "write" class, which always asks, even for a read. The context above is only a default too: the string can still override it with its own flags.
infraGate.brief.risk.unknownAccount: AWOG does not know which account this is — the profile has not had an identity check, so it is scored as PRODUCTION (not knowing where you are means assuming the worst place). The command runs against whatever the CLI resolves for itself, usually the `default` profile.
infraGate.brief.risk.write: Medium: something changes, but it can be reversed.
infraGate.brief.riskShort.bypass: Temporary bypass is on — this class runs without asking.
infraGate.brief.riskShort.narrowed: This session narrowed its own infra permissions.
infraGate.brief.riskShort.shell: Shell string: always asks as "write", and it may override the context.
infraGate.brief.riskShort.unknownAccount: Account not verified — treated as PRODUCTION; usually runs on the `default` profile.
infraGate.hint.bypass: A temporary bypass is on, so commands in this class are running without asking until it expires.
infraGate.hint.narrowed: This session narrowed its own infrastructure permissions, so you are asked even where Settings would allow it.
infraGate.noRemember: Infrastructure commands are never remembered — every call is a fresh question.
infraGate.sentence.context-switch: The agent wants to change the pinned infrastructure context.
infraGate.sentence.destructive: The agent wants to run a destructive command — it deletes or tears resources down.
infraGate.sentence.read: The agent wants to run a read-only infrastructure command.
infraGate.sentence.write: The agent wants to run a command that changes infrastructure.
infraGate.title: Infrastructure command
